title: KeyDisable
description: allows you to disable and free up any key you don't like, with a nice visual.
body:
# Some keybinds don't deserve to live.

That's why KeyDisable exists! 

Disable any keybind you don't want with the click of a button. Simple.

**All you have to do is click the no entry symbol next to the keybind you want to remove, and BOOM, no more keybind.**

To undo it, simply press "reset" or change it to a different key.

![Image of mod tooltip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ce6e85393f3faf0263471476ad4ab13bb00bc09.png)

It's also compatible with almost all mods, and it even frees up the key for a different keybind!


![Image of what the mod does](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7dc5d881e087eb065156afeabb41eac50549ab77.png)
